prompt: Flag code that treats a comparison result or mask as a number: a true mask spelled `1.0` (or any constant other than via `OpKind::mask`), arithmetic on a mask, a bitwise-domain result passed through a numeric fold or a finiteness check that would read all-ones as NaN. Also flag constant folding of an op whose result differs by target (Min/Max with NaN or signed zeros, Gt/Ge with NaN, Round ties, Recip/Rsqrt, TruncToInt out of range, out-of-range shifts) at build time.
